name: Tabs Bar
description:
The `p-tabs-bar` component is a styled button/link list for multiple purposes. You can use it with your framework router
to ensure your **window location** updates on tab click, use it for **hash routing** and displaying content accordingly
to the hash, as **skip navigation** to move on a longer page or to **change the state** of another element and therefore
change the appearance of your content .
code:
` component and it will handle all styling behaviors. In order to get notified when the active tabs change, you need to register an event listener for the `update` event which is emitted by `p-tabs-bar`. The tabChange event has been deprecated and will be removed with the next major release.
Please use the update event instead. ### Framework Implementations ### Buttons ### Links ### Accessibility hints The `p-tabs-bar` component is detached from the content which belongs to the active tab. We provide the necessary `role="tab"`, `tabindex` and `aria-selected` on the tabs inside the component. To be truly accessible you need to provide some more information because every tab needs an `aria-controls` attribute which points to the corresponding `id` of the `tabpanel`. The content placeholder needs the `role="tabpanel"` and the attribute `aria-labelledby` which points to the unique id of the corresponding tab (`aria-controls`). You must also take care of the focus handling of the tabpanel. Therefore the active tab panel must have an `tabindex="0"` to receive keyboard focus and the focus indicator must be styled accordingly. Use the provided [focus style](styles/focus) like this: ``` p-tabs-bar ~ [tabindex="0"][role="tabpanel"] { @include pds-focus; } ``` --- ## Active Tab **Note:** Keep in mind that the property `active-tab-index` uses zero-based numbering. Setting `active-tab-index` to `undefined` removes the selection. Make sure to update the `activeTabIndex` when adding or removing elements. ## Size ## Weight The semibold value has been deprecated and will be removed with the next major release.
Please use the semi-bold value instead. ## Gradient color If the amount of tabs exceeds the viewport, the component renders arrow-buttons to help with horizontal scrolling. The background and gradient has to align to your chosen background. The gradientColorScheme property has been deprecated and will be removed with the next major release.
Please use the gradientColor property instead.

tabChange.description: @deprecated since v3.0.0, will be removed with next major release, use `update` event instead. Emitted when active tab is changed.

update.description: Emitted when active tab is changed.

activeTabIndex.description: Defines which tab to be visualized as selected (zero-based numbering), undefined if none should be selected.

gradientColor.description: Adapts the background gradient color of prev and next button.

gradientColorScheme.description: @deprecated since v3.0.0, will be removed with next major release, use `gradientColor` instead. Adapts the background gradient color of prev and next button.

theme.description: Adapts the color when used on dark background.

slotsMeta.description: Default slot for the `button` or `a` tags which will be rendered as tabs.
